messages:
laura: Quick sync — we need to lock the partner SDK compatibility cadence for the April marketplace listing + SI rollouts. Draft plan: 3-week deprecation notice, 2-week canary with SI testers, 1-week embargoed joint announcement. Thoughts?
sam: Sounds sensible. Is the breaking bit the header change only or payload schema too?
laura: Primary change is header -> we swap X-RW-Auth to Authorization v2. Small payload tweak for batch ops (field rename).
jin: Can we ship a shim in the SDKs for one release cycle? That buys partners time.
marta: SI side: need 2 full CI runs against canary images, plus a checklist for integrators. Can we provide dockerized mock endpoints?
laura: Yes — eng-platform will drop a mock server image and a migration test harness. @partners-bot can you create a repo and invite SI leads? :eyes:
partners-bot: Created repo https://go.team/redwood/partner-sdk-migration and invited: marta, olivia, jin. CI template added.
olivia: Need clarity on marketplace images — will the dedicated marketplace package still accept old headers until the grace period ends?
sam: We should keep compatibility layer in the marketplace gateway for 30 days after GA. That avoids immediate breakage.
laura: Agreed. Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (today): announce deprecation to partners privately, open migration repo
- Week 1: SDK shims + docs + mock server + SI test invites
- Week 2: Canary with ~5 SI partners, marketplace gateway shim active
- Week 3: Gradual enforce of new header on hosted API; marketplace shim remains for 30 days
- Week 6: Shim removed, public docs updated, joint announcement (if SIs green)

marta: Can we compress weeks 1-2 if SI test results are clean? A 2-week total runway would help our joint PR timing.
laura: Possibly, but marketing needs 7 calendar days for joint content. We'll aim for 3 weeks but keep option to accelerate by 1 week.
sam: What about embedded devices from hardware partners? They often run old stacks and can't get SDK updates quickly. Need a long-tail plan.
jin: For hardware partners, offer a vendor shim package they can run on an edge gateway. Also ship a tiny example in C++ showing header translation.
olivia: Also confirm telemetry names so we can detect partners still using old header. Add metric: partner_sdk_migration.old_header_hits{partner_id}.
laura: Good call. Eng-sre can add that. We'll include a rolling alert if any top-10 partners exceed 1% old-header traffic after week 2.
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: "PartnerSDK migration kickoff" on 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC.
laura: Docs snippet for migration (put in repo README):
```
# migrate header
Old: X-RW-Auth: <token>
New: Authorization: Bearer <v2-token>
# simple curl migration
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.rw/token_v2)" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sam: We'll need sample tests for batch rename too. Something like: `batch.items[].text -> batch.entries[].input` and a flag `--compat-batch` in SDKs.
jin: SDK owners: I'll open PRs to add `--compat-batch` and the header shim in node/python/rs. ETA: 5 business days.
marta: SI checklist items I'd like: 1) functional smoke test, 2) end-to-end latency test, 3) token accounting verification, 4) onboarding doc for field renames. I'll draft and push to the repo.
laura: Comms: we want to avoid a public deprecation blog until after SI canary is green. Internal signal plan: product + partnerships get a go/no-go 48 hours before public.
olivia: Legal asks that we include a 30-day grace in partner contracts for this specific migration. I'll loop in contracts.
laura: Risks: 1) hardware partners can't use shim -> potential support spikes, 2) marketplace integrators assume old header -> traffic drop, 3) SDK release delays. Mitigations: longer shim, gateway compatibility, extra test automation.
sam: Does anyone object to the timeline as-is? If not, I'll create the partner-facing deprecation email draft.
marta: No objections from SI track.
jin: No objections from SDK side.
olivia: Go ahead. I'll coordinate legal and marketplace listing text.
laura: Great — Sam, please start the email draft and share in the repo. Partners-team: please review by EOD. :thumbsup:
partners-bot: Thread pinned to #partnerships and an action card created in the migration board: "partner header migration: announce + shims".
